reasons.realCost: Webflow's small-team and growing-team real bills reach $167/mo and $732/mo against a $39/mo Premium sticker price, almost entirely because metered bandwidth add-ons scale with traffic rather than staying fixed.
reasons.pricingHonesty: Every Site and Workspace plan, per-seat rate, bandwidth-overage tier and usage charge is listed with exact dollar figures on webflow.com/pricing without needing a sales call.
reasons.smallTeamFit: Webflow's own pricing page lists owners who want a simple template editor with no design learning curve as a poor fit, since the visual canvas assumes design skill beyond drag-and-drop.
reasons.doesTheJob: Premium bundles a 20,000-item CMS, custom code, Webflow Cloud apps and localization into one plan, covering ground that would otherwise need separate CMS, hosting and localization tools.
reasons.freedomToLeave: Code exports free on any paid Workspace plan, but CMS content exports one Collection at a time, forms stop working after export, and canceling still leaves the rest of the current term billed.
reasons.trackRecord: Webflow has operated since 2013 with a public status page, and its May 2026 update merged the CMS and Business plans into a single Premium tier.

basis: Webflow's CMS and code depth are among the strongest of the four, but for a small non-technical owner the real bill is driven by metered bandwidth that can run many times the sticker price, and leaving cleanly takes real migration work.
method: Two separate AI passes (two runs of Anthropic's Claude over the same evidence, neither seeing the other's score) scored six factors (1–5) and an overall; published overall is the lower of the two overall scores, because this tool runs an affiliate program we have joined or may join. Pass scores: 3.1 and 3.6.
